name: A Simple Compass
summary: At the burned Alexston Farmstead in Westfall, A Simple Compass lies in a small chest. It belonged to Baros Alexston before he became Stormwind's City Architect.

sections.title: A Boyhood Keepsake
sections.body: Baros Alexston grew up working his family's farm in Westfall. His first instrument for finding his way was a simple compass. It may have kindled his interest in geometry, drafting, and exploration. Then the Defias Brotherhood raided and burned the farmstead, leaving the compass in a sturdy chest among the ruins as bandits overran the farmland.

sections.title: Sentimental Value
sections.body: Baros's father escaped the destruction, but could not carry the family's possessions to safety. Inside Stormwind City's stone walls, the compass has little use to a master builder. Yet it means much to Baros. Its return would restore a rare, intact link to his humble beginnings and the peaceful countryside of his childhood.

faq.answer: As a boy on his family's Westfall farm, Baros Alexston owned A Simple Compass, a modest, non-magical pocket compass.
The compass lies inside Alexston's Chest in the burned-out ruins of the Alexston Farmstead, just west of Sentinel Hill in Westfall.
Baros Alexston, Stormwind's City Architect, wants the compass returned. He can be found near the town hall in Cathedral Square.

faq.q: Why was the compass left behind at the farm?
aliases: why did they leave the compass
faq.answer: The Defias outlaws raided and burned the Alexston farm. Baros's father fled for his life and could not carry the family's heavier possessions, so the chest remained in the wreckage.

angles.text: Helping Baros Alexston recover his keepsake shows the human cost of the Defias uprising. Even prominent leaders in Stormwind have lost their family homes to the turmoil in Westfall.
As a human of the kingdom, you can see the contrast in the compass: Stormwind City's safe, gilded courtyards and Westfall's abandoned, lawless frontier.
